notes: GMSL2 camera platform for the Jetson T5000: up to 8 cameras, MAX9296A deserializers, power over coax. Only if the cameras are GMSL2, which nothing has chosen. From search excerpts of the datasheet on 2026-11-05.

SiCore 450 Wh/kg, silicon anode with a liquid electrolyte: fills the durable tier by density, not by its preferred chemistry (spec 03.1). No specific cell part number or public price found on 2026-09-26; cycle life and an abuse-test result not in hand (2026-11-05).
Solid-state pouch, 465 Wh/kg at stack level (hardware/electrical 3): the preferred chemistry of spec 03.1. Not a product listing.

24 to 180 cells in series (expansion modules past 24), passive balancing 200 mA, CAN 2.0B. From search excerpts of the specification sheet on 2026-11-05, the sheet itself not read. For a pack above 16 cells in series; D-4 sets the count.
1 to 16 cells in series. Fits a pack of about 48 V, which the 18-52 V drive board of the AKH70 implies if D-2 keeps it (hardware/electrical 2); D-4 open. From search excerpts on 2026-11-05.
Isolated half-brick, 48 V in, 12 V 20.83 A, 250 W. From a distributor listing as excerpted by search on 2026-11-05. Only for a 48 V bus (D-4).
DCM3717 family: non-isolated, 40-60 V in, 10.0-13.5 V out, 750 W. The family, not a part number: the full ordering code was not read. From search excerpts on 2026-11-05.

Jetson T5000 module (AGX Thor). Selected in hardware/electrical 4. Module price not public in any source found on 2026-09-26. USD 3,499 is the developer kit 945-14070-0080-000, which contains this module; it is not this part.

Gauntlet carrier for the Jetson T5000: 2x 10GBASE-T, 2x 1GbE, 2x M.2 NVMe; works with Connect Tech's GMSL2/GMSL3 camera platforms. A reseller price of USD 2,054 was seen in a search excerpt on 2026-11-05 and is not recorded as verified. Sized for a rack or enclosure; fit in the torso not checked.
Rogue-T5 carrier for the Jetson T5000, rugged locking connectors. From a reseller listing as excerpted by search on 2026-11-05.
Industrial carrier for the Jetson T5000: dual 10GbE, PCIe x16, CSI-2 cameras. About EUR 599-799 by variant per a news article, not a price page. From search excerpts on 2026-11-05.

Stand-alone CAN FD to EtherCAT gateway, EtherCAT SubDevice, galvanically isolated. Aimed at automotive test benches: fit with a joint protocol at the balance rate not checked. From search excerpts on 2026-11-05.
EtherCAT to 4-channel CAN FD, also USB and Ethernet; sold for robot control networks. A price of EUR 74.95 was seen in a search excerpt on 2026-11-05 and is not recorded as verified.
EtherCAT to CAN FD module, 3 CAN channels, up to 24 motors, for humanoids. No manufacturer part number on the listing as excerpted by search on 2026-11-05.
